The members of each order in attendance at the end of the previous summit determine precedence for the following summit according to the [[Principle of Precedence]]. The income of mana following the previous summit is listed above and was distributed as per the table below. This left 3 mana, which will be added to the font of the next summit along with the income from the Principle of Proportions at this summit.

==Friday Declarations==
===Concord: Civil Service and the Unfettered Mind===
* '''Raised by:''' Abel the Bursar
* '''Declaration:''' That if the civil service wants advice on arcane projections it should ask the Grandmaster of the Unfettered Mind and not a sorcerer.
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Eirwen Brackensong===
* '''Raised by:''' Lord Armand Remys
* '''Declaration:''' Eirwen Brackensong is an inspiration to the mages of the Empire
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Sorcery: Ephrael and Kerioth===
* '''Raised by:''' Solomon
* '''Declaration:''' Ephrael and Kerioth of Zephaniah's Lament
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Throne Candidacy===
* '''Raised by:''' Solomon
* '''Declaration:''' Conclave believes that a candidate for the throne worthy of the title "master of magic" should be able to demonstrate their competence by securing an endorsement of their candidacy from conclave, via a suitable worded declaration of concord
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Tactical and Strategic Magic===
* '''Raised by:''' Enchantress Olivia Sepulchre
* '''Declaration:''' Conclave believes that until such time as an Imperial position is created the organisation of tactical and strategic use of battlefield magic liaising with the field marshal should fall to the Enchantress Olivia Sepulchre as part of the rod and shield.
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Restrict Imperial Lore===
* '''Raised by:''' Gregor
* '''Declaration:''' That only Imperial citizens should have unfettered access to Imperial lore
* '''Outcome:''' Failed

===Concord: Recognise Chiara i Zayden===
* '''Raised by:''' Sagremar
* '''Declaration:''' Conclave recognises Chiara i Zayden, ritualist and magus, as a candidate for the throne
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Candidacy: Imperial Magus===
* '''Raised by:''' Lucia Amato van Holberg
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Candidacy: Imperial Magus===
* '''Raised by:''' Ashborn Trosk
* '''Outcome:''' Failed

===Candidacy: Imperial Magus===
* '''Raised by:''' Solomon
* '''Outcome:''' Failed

===Candidacy: Dean of the Lyceum===
* '''Raised by:''' Andronicus Netherwatch
* '''Outcome:''' Failed

===Candidacy: Dean of the Lyceum===
* '''Raised by:''' Severin de Rondell
* '''Outcome:''' Failed

==Saturday Declarations==
===Concord: Endorse Vincent Vexille===
* '''Raised by:''' Ser Fabienne de Miel
* '''Declaration:''' We the Conclave endorse Lord Vincent Vexille as a candidate for the throne
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Endorse Skywise Fal===
* '''Raised by:''' Skywise Fal
* '''Declaration:''' Conclave endorse Skywise Fal as a candidate for the throne
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Embassies for Eternals===
* '''Raised by:''' Brother Luke
* '''Declaration:''' Conclave endorses the investigation to the building of embassies for eternals and/or the realms, as per the request of Eleonaris
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Responsibility of Morien de Carsenere===
* '''Raised by:''' Enchantress Morien de Carsenere
* '''Declaration:''' Conclave will consider the Enchantress Morien de Carsenere responsible for the consequences of their mass summer ritual for better or worse
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Endorse Brendan Brackensong===
* '''Raised by:''' Brendan Brackensong
* '''Declaration:''' Conclave endorse Brendan Brackensong as a candidate for the throne
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Archmage Addresses===
* '''Raised by:''' Sovica Martova Kovar
* '''Declaration:''' Conclave agree that realm reports by archmages should be classed separately to addresses
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Minute to Discuss===
* '''Raised by:''' Gregor
* '''Declaration:''' That the "minute to discuss" declarations within the orders be reinstated
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Lists of Membership===
* '''Raised by:''' Gregor
* '''Declaration:''' That the lists of order members be provided once again to the grandmasters and not posted for public attention unless at the behest of the orders grandmaster
* '''Outcome:''' Failed

===Concord: Endorse Chiara i Zayden i Riqueza===
* '''Raised by:''' Chiara i Zayden i Riqueza
* '''Declaration:''' That the Conclave endorse Chiara i Zayden i Riqueza as a candidate for the throne
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Alter Unfettered Mind Manifesto===
* '''Raised by:''' Palaphon Ankarien
* '''Declaration:''' That the manifesto of the Unfettered Mind be altered to include "to guide and support the  creation and codification of useful arcane projections"
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Endorse Yulia Kasimirova Voronov===
* '''Raised by:''' Yulia Kasimirova Voronov
* '''Declaration:''' That we the Conclave endorse Yulia Kasimirova Voronov as a candidate for the Throne
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Deliver Scroll===
* '''Raised by:''' Tiberius Storms End
* '''Declaration:''' Phaleron should deliver the scroll regarding Myfanwy of Hercynia to Tonrak Agilia Heirthane Renwyrd
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Interdiction: Golden Hare Icon of Irra Harah===
* '''Raised by:''' Ingar Ironbreaker
* '''Declaration:''' Interdiction of golden hare, icon of Irra Harah
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Resolve Tortured Souls===
* '''Raised by:''' Xanthippe of the Lighthouse at Nikephoros
* '''Declaration:''' Conclave asks for magicians to come forward and develop magical solutions to the threat of Tortured Souls trapped by the Druj
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Investigate Sentinel Gate===
* '''Raised by:''' Xenia of Ephemeris
* '''Declaration:''' ...that it is an appropriate use of experimental magica to investigate the creation of the Sentinel Gate
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Arcane Projections===
* '''Raised by:''' Limonos
* '''Declaration:''' Conclave agrees that too much mana is being spent on Arcane Projections
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Concord: Ephisis' Scale===
* '''Raised by:''' Archmage Edmundo
* '''Declaration:''' This conclave believes that the use of the ritual "Ephisis' Scale" to send the heart of an Imperial citizen is a misuse of magic
* '''Outcome:''' Passed

===Neutrality: Ossegrahn===
* '''Raised by:''' Ser Elienne De La Chasse 
* '''Declaration:''' The Spring eternal Ossegrahn (aka Lord Rain) is reset to neutrality
* '''Outcome:''' Passed
